title: Frontend resource sync
description: Brings the pages of a resource (form, list, detail) in line with its contract: adds the fields it lacks, removes those the contract dropped.

name.description: Resource name, singular or plural (e.g. orders).

lib.description: Frontend lib (packages/frontend/<lib>) the resource is in; found by itself when left out.

keep.description: Only add the missing fields: keep (and report) what the contract dropped.
